manifest.goal: decide whether an adult woman's microcytic anaemia is from iron deficiency or from thalassaemia trait

known_facts.text: adult female haemoglobin lower reference limit 12.0 g/dL
microcytosis is a mean cell volume below 80 fL

unknowns.text: the cause of the microcytic anaemia

options.falsifier: a serum ferritin of 100 ng/mL or more
a normal haemoglobin electrophoresis (HbA2 at most 3.5%)

derivations.claim: haemoglobin is {v} g/dL below the lower reference limit
the mean cell volume is {v} fL below the microcytosis threshold

expected_outcome.missing: the date the harm was discovered

manifest.goal: decide whether a claim filed 800 days after the incident is time-barred under a 2-year limitation period

known_facts.text: the claim was filed 800 days after the incident
the limitation period is 2 years (730 days)

unknowns.text: the day the harm was discovered (not in the file)
whether the claim is in time

options.falsifier: evidence that the harm could not have been discovered before day 70

options.text: the claim is timely under the discovery rule
assumptions: the discovery rule applies to this claim
options.falsifier: evidence that the harm was discovered before day 70

derivations.claim: measured from the incident, the claim is {v} days outside the period

manifest.goal: decide whether an existing steel beam of undocumented grade is adequate for a 120 kN·m bending moment

assumptions: the steel is at least grade S275
options.falsifier: a coupon test yield strength below 225 MPa

assumptions: the steel is an older mild steel near 210 MPa
